This is the single bounded native Desktop qualification repair. Use the normal graph client and finish with graph.submit(interactionNode) or its documented terminal equivalent. Do not delegate, call recursiveComplete, execute invoke controls, browse, use external services, or modify unrelated files. Do not retry by creating another interaction.
The attached accepted Launch decision node id 22, clientKey launch-decision, occurs in source root 7 and child 6. Its title and semantic detail must remain exactly unchanged. Its three accepted controls are Draft rollout recommendation, Release readiness, Readiness checklist. Read getNodePresentation for current revision and actual action identities/provenance.
Create one independent response root with exactly two connected nodes titled Release summary and Next steps, summarizing this synthetic readiness walkthrough without external factual claims. Add exactly ONE node-owned Reference on the attached node, clientKey native-final-readiness-reference, label Final readiness, targeting this new response root. Omit sourceLayer on the new action and binding. Do not insert the attached node into the new response.
Explicitly stage a full compiled Node Detail replacement through replaceNodePresentation. Preserve and expose all three existing controls with exact original identities, kinds, and source-layer provenance; add the fourth Final readiness control. Preserve the node's persistent clientKey and semantic text. Use a compact polished layout, and let normal terminal acceptance publish the new action and replacement atomically. Do not fabricate buttons or discard older controls. Read the shipped public type declarations where needed. This is one completion only.
